001package com.fs.starfarer.api.characters;
002
003public class FullName {
004        
005        public static enum Gender{
006                MALE,
007                FEMALE,
008                ANY,
009        }
010        
011        private String first, last;
012        private Gender gender;
013
014        public FullName(String first, String last, Gender gender) {
015                this.first = first;
016                this.last = last;
017                this.gender = gender;
018        }
019        public Gender getGender() {
020                return gender;
021        }
022        public void setGender(Gender gender) {
023                this.gender = gender;
024        }
025        public String getFirst() {
026                return first;
027        }
028        public void setFirst(String first) {
029                this.first = first;
030        }
031        public String getLast() {
032                return last;
033        }
034        public void setLast(String last) {
035                this.last = last;
036        }
037        public String getFullName() {
038                return (first + " " + last).trim();
039        }
040}
